# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Rewrote `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_chloride_protection.rs` so `test_salt_treatment_emergency_scenario` now models a real mid-run salt treatment through `PlayerAction::WaterChangePercent` and a chloride-rich source-water profile. The scenario now confirms the tank enters a nitrite crash first, raises chloride via the existing water-change/source-water path while keeping nitrite elevated, and then asserts the post-treatment mortality rate drops relative to the pre-treatment window. I also revalidated the existing low-vs-high chloride mortality-probability and nitrite diagnosability coverage with focused tests.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the current chloride-protection implementation and confirmed the remaining net gap was the integration scenario still starting with elevated chloride instead of applying chloride during an ongoing nitrite crisis.
1. [Completed] Updated `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_chloride_protection.rs` to build a validated salty source-water profile, apply a 50% emergency water change mid-run, verify chloride rises while nitrite stays high, and compare pre- vs post-treatment mortality rates within the same simulation.
2. [Completed] Ran focused validation for the emergency scenario and the already-present mortality/diagnostic coverage tied to the remediation requirements.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_chloride_protection test_salt_treatment_emergency_scenario -- --exact`
- `cargo test -p tank_core systems::shrimp::tests::test_high_nitrite_low_chloride_vs_high_chloride -- --exact`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test tracing trace_verbosity_reports_chloride_adjusted_nitrite_stress_diagnostics -- --exact`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test events nitrite_warning_summary_reports_effective_hazard_and_stress_increment -- --exact`
- `git diff --check -- crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_chloride_protection.rs`

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation in this turn was targeted to the chloride/nitrite remediation cases; I did not rerun the full `cargo test -p tank_core` suite.
